audience: SEO specialists and marketers who track keyword rankings with Wincher

useCases.title: Find which keywords rank in the top 10
useCases.text: The AI lists the keywords tracked for a website with their latest position, best position, volume and difficulty, and picks out the ones near the top.

useCases.title: See how rankings changed over time
useCases.text: The AI reads the position history of one keyword, or of up to 50 keywords at once, so you can see which ones moved up or down.

useCases.title: Look at the search results page for a keyword
useCases.text: The AI reads the latest stored search result pages of a keyword, with SERP features and the ranking position, URL and domain of each result.

useCases.title: Compare your rankings with competitors
useCases.text: The AI lists tracked competitors, compares ranking summaries such as average position and share of voice, and shows your position and theirs for each keyword.

useCases.title: Review keyword groups or create a new one
useCases.text: The AI lists keyword groups with average difficulty and ranking summary, and creates a group that holds existing keywords.

useCases.title: Add new keywords to track
useCases.text: The AI checks your keyword usage, then starts tracking up to 50 new keywords on one website. Each keyword uses a slot, and this tool cannot remove it again.
